state:
**Side goal `test-scratch-and-hover`, stage 2.** `nvs_repo::scratch(name) -> Scratch` is on disk (`crates/nvs-repo/src/lib.rs`): a fresh directory `target/test-scratch/<name>-<pid>-<n>`, deleted when the guard drops. The guard `no_test_code_writes_into_the_system_temp_dir` is in `crates/nvs-repo/tests/scratch.rs`, with `SUBJECT` (empty) and the `NOT_YET_MOVED` ratchet, which fails when a file's count moves either way. Moving a site means lowering or deleting its row in the same commit.

**22 of the 25 `nvs-cli` calls are moved** (73 calls left). The pattern: a helper that returned a `PathBuf` now returns the `Scratch` (or `(Scratch, path)`), and the test binds it as `_dir` for as long as it reads the files. `script.rs`'s edit helpers return a `Case` with `say`/`run` methods for the edit. A `Scratch` is not `Into<PathBuf>` and does not index a `HashMap<PathBuf, _>`: pass `dir.path()` or `&*case`.

**The three left are blocked on ownership, not on effort:** `cache.rs`, `config.rs` and `tests/init.rs` run the ownership check against their scratch directory, and `target/` on this machine inherits a write grant to `Authenticated Users` (playbook, *Writing a test case*). Moving them failed 27 tests. Moving them for real needs an owner-only scratch directory. Stage 3 (hover) is not started.

next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-repo/src/lib.rs`, `crates/nvs-repo/tests/scratch.rs` and the three trust-checked `nvs-cli` test modules.

items.text: **An owner-only scratch directory.** Add a call to `nvs-repo` (for example `nvs_repo::scratch_private(name)`, or have `scratch` itself lock `target/test-scratch/` down once): on Unix mode `0700`, on Windows `icacls <dir> /inheritance:r /grant:r <current user>:(OI)(CI)F`. The trust check also reads the parent, so the locked directory must be a parent of the case directory. Pin it with a test that runs `nvs_config::trust` against it — `crates/nvs-repo/src/lib.rs:219`

**Move `cache.rs`, `config.rs` and `tests/init.rs` onto it**, deleting their three rows. The edits were made once and reverted: each local `scratch(name)` helper becomes a call into `nvs-repo`; `Cache::new(&dir, ..)` needs `dir.path()`; `crates/nvs-cli/tests/init.rs:366`'s `[&outer, &inner]` becomes `[outer.path(), inner.as_path()]` — `crates/nvs-cli/src/cache.rs:1813`, `crates/nvs-cli/src/config.rs:741`, `crates/nvs-cli/tests/init.rs:20`, `crates/nvs-repo/tests/scratch.rs:18`

**Move the `nvs-lsp` sites (18 rows)**, the same way. Many only build a URI with `uri_of(&std::env::temp_dir().join(..))` and never write the file: give those a path under one `Scratch` the test holds. A site whose subject is the system temp directory goes to `SUBJECT` with its reason — `crates/nvs-lsp/src/definition.rs:1597`, `crates/nvs-lsp/src/document.rs:808`, `crates/nvs-lsp/tests/navigation.rs:230`

backlog: Move the rest (`nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-runtime`, `nvs-test`, `nvs-host`, `nvs-db`, `nvs-server`, `nvs-config`, `nvs-types`, `nvs-hir`, `nvs-footprint`): `crates/nvs-repo/tests/scratch.rs`. Any of them that runs the ownership check needs the owner-only directory too.
Stage 3: hover on a `use` line, an `implements` clause and type positions; references list `use` lines and the lens does not count them (`docs/agent/goals/side/test-scratch-and-hover.md`).
`crates/nvs-cli/src/service.rs` and `crates/nvs-cli/src/tmp.rs` still end tests with an explicit `remove_dir_all(&root)`. That is harmless because the guard's drop ignores a missing directory.
